create_QkNormRopePattern: create a QkNormRopePattern to match and replace unfused qkv split, rms_norm, and rotary embedding with a fused op
build_QKNormRoPEFusionPass: build a QKNormRoPEFusionPass that fuses Q/K RMSNorm and RoPE into a single fused_qk_norm_rope call in an Inductor pass
register_QkNormRopePattern: register a QkNormRopePattern with a PatternMatcherPass to enable pattern matching and replacement in the graph
apply_QKNormRoPEFusionPass: apply the QKNormRoPEFusionPass to an fx.Graph to fuse QK Norm+RoPE patterns and return the matched site count
test_QkNormRopePattern_inputs: test QkNormRopePattern get_inputs to generate sample tensors for pattern tracing
